# ViewGum skills

> Agent skills and an MCP connector for vertical short video, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents that read
> skills. Seven skills work with no account (specs, script writing and cleanup, hook grading, post copy, upload checks, AI
> labels); viewgum-shorts makes, edits and exports finished shorts through ViewGum's connector, which needs a paid ViewGum plan.

- [README](https://github.com/viewgum/skills/blob/main/README.md): what each skill does and how to install it in each agent
- [skills/](https://github.com/viewgum/skills/tree/main/skills): one folder per skill, each with a SKILL.md
- [.mcp.json](https://github.com/viewgum/skills/blob/main/.mcp.json): the connector, https://viewgum.com/mcp (streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in)

Install: npx skills add viewgum/skills, or claude plugin marketplace add viewgum/skills

## Related

- [Connect an AI assistant](https://viewgum.com/agents): steps for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Codex, Cursor and others
- [business-video-skills](https://github.com/viewgum/business-video-skills): video plans and ad rules for small businesses by industry
- [ffmpeg-vertical-video](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video): tested FFmpeg commands for 9:16 video, as an agent skill
- [short-form-captions](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-captions): word timestamps to SRT, WebVTT or ASS captions inside the safe zone, and a caption checker
- [in-this-town-story-skill](https://github.com/viewgum/in-this-town-story-skill): In this town and In this world story scripts to the eleven measured beats, with a pace and line checker
